messages:
asha_newhire: Hi all 👋 I'm Asha, just started today on ML infra. Can someone help me get Datadog, Grafana, and Sentry access so I can complete the observability onboarding checklist?

devex_lead: Welcome Asha! :tada: Quick wins: check Okta for Grafana/Datadog/Sentry apps, then open a #help ticket if any app missing. If you need immediate access tag @infra_sam or @sre_nina here.

infra_sam: I can add you to Datadog. Send me your corporate email. Default role is viewer; if you need more, say so.

onboard-bot: NOTE: Provisioning is typically <48 hours for Sentry and Grafana, immediate for Datadog via group sync. If you need emergency access for an onboarding demo, state it in the ticket.

asha_newhire: Thanks! email is asha.patel@redwood.ai. Also would like to view the "models / inference-latency" and "infra / default overview" dashboards.

infra_sam: Added to `redwood-datadog-viewers`, you should get an invite. Check spam if you don't see it.

sre_nina: For Grafana, we map Okta groups to org roles. If you don't see the dashboards after Okta, file #help with the dashboard links and whether you need viewer or editor. For Sentry, tell me which projects you need. Example template in #help:

-- Request start --
Email: asha.patel@redwood.ai
Grafana dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/models-inference-latency
Sentry projects: inference, model-monitoring
Role: viewer
-- Request end --

asha_newhire: Filed the #help ticket with that template and included the Grafana links. Marked as "onboarding priority".

infra_sam: Datadog access confirmed, you can log in at https://app.datadoghq.com/. If metrics are missing, give it ~10 minutes for dashboards to populate.

devex_lead: Once everything is provisioned, follow the checklist in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONBOARD/Observability. Ping me if the checklist item "confirm alert notifications" needs a test.

sre_nina: Sentry invite sent for inference project. Let me know if you need issue write perms.

asha_newhire: All good — Datadog + Grafana viewer + Sentry access received. Thanks for the speedy help everyone :heart:
